Features of the ERAP's Sagip Niyugan program - The
Program shall provide the coconut farmers and coconut processing sector the
following assistance:
(a) lncome Supplement Projects, for coconut farmers to sell their copra
and husked nuts at millgate price or better, as follows:
(1) Transport allowance to coconut farmers where nor"rnr*n,
shoulders the costs of transport of copra ancl husked nuts
from farm to mill until prices go beyond the production cost
of P6.04 per kilogram of copra.;
(2) Marketing assistance to qoconut farmers, including transport
equipment assistance to coconut farmer organizations and
accredited oil mills or desiccators;
(3) Direct buying of copra by the National
Food Authority (NFA) at a base price determined by the
Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA);
(4) lncome support on regular sales of copra and husked nuts
directly benefiting coconut farmers througlr the issuance of
incentive coupons the value of which, as determined by
PCA, shall be based on the volume delivered; and
(5) Livestock and seedling dispersal through the PCA and
accredited farmer organizations.
(b) Coconut Fuel Project which will utilize crude coconut oil (CNO) and
coconut methyl ester (coco-diesel) as substitute or extender for
bunker fuel and diesel fuel, respectively:
(1) Bunker Fuet-Coconut Oil Complementation Project, where
bunker fuel users may substitute 5% to fi% of their fuel
requirement with CNO;

(2) Diesel Fuel-Coconut Methyl Ester Complementation Project,
where diesel fuel users may substitute up to 70% of their
diesel fuel requirement with coco-diesel;
(c) Accelerate the implementation of priority projects under the
Maunlad Na Niyugan Tugon Sa Kahirapan Program adopted by the
Administration under E.O. No. 210, dated February 10, 2000,
including, but not limited to, processing of coconut products and by-
products, establishment of small village type oil mills, operation of
sari-sari stores, livestock dispersal, aquaculture and horticulture.

lmplementation of the ERAP's Sagip Niyugan Progranr -
The Program shall be implemented through a joint venture agreement between
the PCA and accredited farmer organizations with nationwide, regional, provincial
or municipal memberships and network. The PCA shall issue such guidelines as
may be necessary in the proper and expeditious implementation of the joint
venture agreement.

Funding - Assets acquired through the coconut levy funds or
by entities financed by the coconut levy fqnds identified by the President for
appropriate disposal or sale, shall be sold or disposed to generate a maximum
fund of ONE BILLION PESOS (P1,000,000,000.00) which shall be managed by a
Committee composed of a Chairman and four (4) members to be appointed by
the President whose term shall be co-terminus with the Program. The
Committee is authorized to organize a Secretariat for the effective performance
of its functions and responsibilities. The Committee may authorize the
disbursement of an amount not to exceed two percenl (2%) of the fund to defray
..personnel and maintenance and operating costs of the Committee and its
Secretariat, consultative meetings with coconut farmers and information
dissemination of the Program.
The PCGG, Office of the Solicitor General and other appropriate
government instrumentality are hereby directed to take all necessary steps to
implement the purposes and objectives of this Executive Order.

Audit of Fund and Submission of Report - The Committee,
. by a majority vote, shall engage the services of a reputable auditing firm to
conduct periodic audits of the fund. lt shall render a quarterly report on all
pertinent transactions and availments of the fund to the Office of the President
within the first three (3) working days of the succeeding quarter.

Termination of the Program The Program shall be
considered terminated upon the exhaustion of the Pl Billion fund.

Authority of the President to Extend the Program - The
President may, by appropriate issuances and when the situation so warrants,
extend the effectivity of the Program and provide additional funds therefor.

Repealing Ghuse All executive orders, rules and
regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby revoked, amended revised and
superceded accordingly.

Effectivity - This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3 rJ day of November, 2000.
